Let \(P{\left(X \right)} = X^{2} + p X + q\) be a polynomial with real coefficients \(p\) and \(q\). One knows that \(P\) has a complex root \(z\) whose imaginary part is equal to \(-4\). In this case, there is a relation between the coefficients \(p\) and \(q\). Determine this relation by giving \(q\) as a function of \(p\).
